title: Flow promotion tool: dev export to test, prod and DR
scenario: Larkspur promotes console-built flows from dev to test, prod and a us-west-2 DR instance. The old script only rewrote QueueId, and a prod release shipped pointing at the dev Lambda and Lex alias. Write the promotion tool that rewrites every environment-specific reference and fails closed on anything it cannot map.
task: Rewrite queue, hours, prompt, flow, module, Lambda (with qualifier), Lex alias and instance references anywhere in Content, including Metadata and embedded strings
Map by logical name through the dev inventory and the target manifest
Report unknown-reference, unmapped-in-target and dangling problems with JSON paths; emit nothing on problems
Emit modules before flows with target ids and a full replacement report
acceptance: prod and DR output match the expected target content
No dev account, dev ids or source region left in output
Missing or unknown resources fail closed; foreign-account ARNs pass through
Output flows still pass validateFlow; input not mutated

practices.label: Week 8 Mon - CI/CD for Connect across Sandbox/Dev/Test/Prod
Week 8 Tue - ARN/ID rewriting, versions and aliases, IaC coverage
